# ZipFlow

> ZipFlow is a free, local-first archive manager for Windows 10 and 11. It inspects an archive before extraction, reports seven classes of security risk with a 0–100 score, and recommends compression settings based on the files inside. It reads 30+ formats, writes seven containers, and exposes the same engine through a GUI, a CLI and a localhost HTTP API. It runs entirely offline.

## Key facts

- Product name: ZipFlow (Chinese: 汇压缩)
- Version: 1.0.0
- Platform: Windows 10 version 1809 or later, Windows 11; x64
- Price: free
- License: LGPL-3.0
- Distribution: Microsoft Store (MSIX, about 53.9 MB) and GitHub Releases (portable build)
- Network: no telemetry, no analytics, no cloud sync; the MSIX manifest does not declare the internetClient capability
- Project repository: https://github.com/lijiannan1241/ZipFlow
- Website: https://lijiannan1241.github.io/ZipFlow/

## What it does

- Archive health report with seven checks: path traversal (Zip Slip, CWE-22), symlink escape, compression bomb, weak encryption, integrity anomalies, embedded executables, duplicate or case-conflicting names.
- Score from 0 to 100, where 100 means no findings. Risk label is determined by the worst finding. Reports export to JSON.
- Compression recommendation: samples the file mix, then suggests a container, method and level with an estimated space saving and runtime.
- Interoperability labels: ★ opens everywhere, ◐ needs a newer OS, ! needs 7-Zip.
- GUI, CLI (`zf`) and local HTTP API share one engine.
- Formats read: 30+, including ZIP, 7z, TAR, TAR.GZ, TAR.BZ2, TAR.XZ, TAR.ZST, RAR (with 7-Zip), ISO, CAB, DMG, LZ, CPIO, RPM, DEB, SquashFS, NSIS, VHD/VHDX/VDI/VMDK, WIM, UDF, EXT, ARJ, LZH, CHM, PPMd, multi-volume and OOXML.
- Formats written: ZIP (default), 7z, TAR, TAR.GZ, TAR.BZ2, TAR.XZ, TAR.ZST.
- ZIP features: Zip64, Deflate levels 1–9, AES-256, optional Zopfli.

## CLI examples

```bash
zf s suspicious.zip --json     # health report as JSON
zf a dist.zip ./src            # create ZIP + Deflate L9
zf a dist.7z ./src -f 7z       # smaller, recipient needs 7-Zip
zf a big.zip ./data --info     # plan only, no file written
zf x dist.zip -o ./out         # extract
zf r ./src --prefer auto       # recommendation
zf t dist.zip                  # integrity test
zf serve --port 8765           # localhost API with bearer token
```

Exit codes: 0 success, 1 general error, 2 usage error, 3 security block, 4 wrong password, 5 external 7-Zip missing.
